title: Continuous scale input response mapping and product feel

scope.subject: Tune the existing Galaxy=0 to Surface=5 continuous coordinate with a stateless reversible response map, cross-segment device feel diagnostics, immediate reversal, and global forward/reverse acceptance without adding inertia, queues, or a second wheel authority

research_summary: The product already owns wheel input in UniverseApp, normalizes WheelEvent units, disables camera-controls wheel ownership, and exposes one real-valued 0..5 scale coordinate. The remaining product-feel gap is response mapping: Galaxy currently requires 384 normalized pixels per scale unit while System/world use 192, creating a large gain discontinuity at the native renderer boundary. Reuse the existing coordinator and pure continuousScale helpers. Express the wheel response as a monotonic stateless mapping over the same coordinate so per-segment gain can be tuned without hidden momentum, phase thresholds, post-tail motion, or reverse asymmetry.

sources.finding: WheelEvent reports delivered signed deltas and deltaMode but does not define product zoom physics; the existing coordinator should remain the sole semantic scale authority.
Wheel samples may vary by device and browser, so perceived response should be mapped after unit normalization rather than by assuming raw notch magnitude.

camera-controls remains the camera executor with wheel actions disabled while Personal Universe owns semantic scale input; reuse its immediate programmatic camera updates rather than adding project inertia.
Pinned MIT YEIS remains the Galaxy/native scale renderer and bridge authority; product input mapping must feed the existing native progress instead of creating a parallel camera controller.

search_ladder.conclusion: Retain the current YEIS-backed Personal Universe scale product and tune its existing coordinator.
Retain the existing R3F scene boundary and React input owner; no new animation loop is needed.
Reuse the existing normalized wheel sample and one 0..5 coordinate; add only a pure response transform and diagnostics.
Keep camera-controls as the camera executor with wheel disabled; do not enable its independent wheel damping.

candidates.name: Stateless monotonic response map on the existing continuous coordinate
candidates.license: project orchestration over existing MIT stack
candidates.reason: Removes cross-segment gain discontinuities while preserving immediate delivery, exact direction changes, one input authority, and no post-input motion.

candidates.name: Re-enable camera-controls wheel dolly/damping
candidates.reason: Creates a second wheel authority and post-delivery motion that cannot preserve semantic renderer handoffs.

candidates.name: Threshold phase stepping or project-owned inertia queue
candidates.reason: Reintroduces staged motion, stale reversal work, and hidden state explicitly forbidden by the product contract.

coverage_matrix.capability: Galaxy through System/Approach has no abrupt response gain jump
coverage_matrix.decision: Use one monotonic response-distance coordinate with explicit per-segment pixel budgets and invert it back to the existing 0..5 coordinate.

coverage_matrix.capability: Forward and reverse samples are symmetric and immediate
coverage_matrix.decision: Make the response transform stateless and invertible; sign changes apply to the very next delivered sample.

coverage_matrix.capability: Approach/Orbit/Atmosphere/Surface tune perceived speed without overshoot or post-tail motion
coverage_matrix.decision: Tune segment budgets in the pure response map, keep sample caps and existing camera executor, and expose response diagnostics for hosted acceptance.

decision.rationale: Extend the existing pure scale helpers and UniverseApp diagnostics only. The response map changes how much of the same 0..5 coordinate a delivered normalized sample consumes; it owns no time, queue, animation, or camera state.
decision.fallback: If hosted evidence shows a local segment still feels too fast or slow, tune only the explicit segment pixel budgets and rerun full forward/reverse acceptance; do not add inertia, thresholds, hidden accumulation, or a second input authority.
